longDescription:
VirtualBox is a cross-platform virtualization application for running multiple operating systems on a single computer. It provides graphical management tools and the VBoxManage command-line interface for creating, configuring, starting, and managing virtual machines.

VirtualBox supports snapshots, configurable virtual networking, shared folders, virtual disk management, and integration features provided by Guest Additions for supported guest operating systems.

The Oracle VM VirtualBox Extension Pack is not included.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export LC_ALL=C
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

VBOX_REPO='https://download.virtualbox.org/virtualbox/debian'
VBOX_KEY_URL="${VBOX_REPO}/oracle_vbox_2016.asc"
VBOX_KEY_FINGERPRINT='B9F8D658297AF3EFC18D5CDFA2F683C52980AECF'
VBOX_SOURCE='/etc/apt/sources.list.d/virtualbox-script2sb.list'
KERNEL_SOURCE='/etc/apt/sources.list.d/minios-kernel-script2sb.list'
MANIFEST='/usr/share/minios/kernel-dpkg/manifest.json'
WORK="/tmp/virtualbox-script2sb.$$"
KEY_ASC="$WORK/oracle-vbox.asc"
KEYRING="$WORK/oracle-vbox.gpg"
HEADER_ROOT="$WORK/header-root"
DEB_DIR="$WORK/debs"
GPG_HOME="$WORK/gnupg"
SHIM_DIR="$WORK/bin"
BEFORE_PKGS="$WORK/before.pkgs"
AFTER_BUILD_PKGS="$WORK/after-build.pkgs"
NEW_BUILD_PKGS="$WORK/new-build.pkgs"
REMOVABLE_PKGS="$WORK/removable.pkgs"
CREATED_LINKS=()

fail() {
    printf 'virtualbox-script2sb: %s\n' "$*" >&2
    exit 1
}
cleanup() {
    local path
    for path in "${CREATED_LINKS[@]:-}"; do
        [ -n "$path" ] && rm -f -- "$path"
    done
    rm -f -- "$VBOX_SOURCE" "$KERNEL_SOURCE"
    rm -rf -- "$WORK"
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM HUP

installed_packages() {
    dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -u
}

map_virtualbox_suite() {
    local id="$1" codename="$2"
    case "$id:$codename" in
        devuan:excalibur) printf '%s\n' trixie ;;
        devuan:daedalus)  printf '%s\n' bookworm ;;
        devuan:chimaera)  printf '%s\n' bullseye ;;
        devuan:beowulf)   printf '%s\n' buster ;;
        devuan:ascii)     printf '%s\n' stretch ;;
        debian:sid|debian:forky|debian:testing) printf '%s\n' trixie ;;
        debian:*|ubuntu:*) printf '%s\n' "$codename" ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}
download_file() {
    local url="$1" output="$2"
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 -o "$output" "$url"
    elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        wget -O "$output" "$url"
    else
        python3 - "$url" "$output" <<'PY'
import sys
import urllib.request
url, output = sys.argv[1:]
with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as response, open(output, 'wb') as target:
    target.write(response.read())
PY
    fi
}

add_kernel_repositories_from_manifest() {
    [ -r "$MANIFEST" ] || return 1
    python3 - "$MANIFEST" >"$KERNEL_SOURCE" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
manifest_path = sys.argv[1]
base = os.path.dirname(manifest_path)
with open(manifest_path, encoding='utf-8') as stream:
    manifest = json.load(stream)
for repository in manifest.get('repositories', []):
    suite = repository.get('suite')
    components = repository.get('components') or []
    architectures = repository.get('architectures') or []
    keyring = (repository.get('keyring') or {}).get('path')
    uris = repository.get('uris') or []
    if not suite or not components or not keyring or not uris:
        continue
    keyring_path = keyring if os.path.isabs(keyring) else os.path.join(base, keyring)
    if not os.path.isfile(keyring_path):
        continue
    options = [f'signed-by={keyring_path}']
    if architectures:
        options.insert(0, 'arch=' + ','.join(architectures))
    for uri in uris:
        print(f"deb [{' '.join(options)}] {uri} {suite} {' '.join(components)}")
PY
    [ -s "$KERNEL_SOURCE" ]
}

candidate_version() {
    apt-cache policy "$1" 2>/dev/null | awk '/Candidate:/ {print $2; exit}'
}

cleanup_build_dependencies() {
    mapfile -t new_packages < <(comm -13 "$BEFORE_PKGS" "$AFTER_BUILD_PKGS")
    [ "${#new_packages[@]}" -gt 0 ] || return 0

    printf '%s\n' "${new_packages[@]}" | sort -u >"$NEW_BUILD_PKGS"
    apt-get -s purge -- "${new_packages[@]}" 2>/dev/null |
        awk '$1 == "Remv" {print $2}' | sed 's/:.*$//' | sort -u >"$REMOVABLE_PKGS"

    comm -23 "$REMOVABLE_PKGS" "$NEW_BUILD_PKGS" >"${REMOVABLE_PKGS}.unexpected"
    if [ -s "${REMOVABLE_PKGS}.unexpected" ]; then
        fail "build-dependency cleanup would remove runtime packages: $(tr '\n' ' ' <"${REMOVABLE_PKGS}.unexpected")"
    fi

    apt-get purge -y -- "${new_packages[@]}"
}

download_header_tree() {
    local package candidate deb path name dependency
    local -a queue=("$HEADER_PACKAGE") seen=()
    mkdir -p "$DEB_DIR" "$HEADER_ROOT"
    chmod 0755 "$WORK" "$DEB_DIR"

    while [ "${#queue[@]}" -gt 0 ]; do
        package="${queue[0]}"
        queue=("${queue[@]:1}")
        case " ${seen[*]} " in *" $package "*) continue ;; esac
        seen+=("$package")
        candidate="$(candidate_version "$package")"
        if [ -z "$candidate" ] || [ "$candidate" = '(none)' ]; then
            fail "required header package is unavailable: $package"
        fi
        (cd "$DEB_DIR" && apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root download "$package")
        deb="$(find "$DEB_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "${package}_*.deb" | head -n1)"
        [ -n "$deb" ] || fail "downloaded package not found: $package"
        while IFS= read -r dependency; do
            [ -n "$dependency" ] || continue
            case " ${seen[*]} ${queue[*]} " in
                *" $dependency "*) ;;
                *) queue+=("$dependency") ;;
            esac
        done < <(dpkg-deb -f "$deb" Depends 2>/dev/null | tr ',' '\n' | sed -E 's/[|].*$//; s/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]].*$//' | grep -E '^linux-(headers|kbuild)-' || true)
    done

    for deb in "$DEB_DIR"/*.deb; do
        [ -f "$deb" ] || continue
        dpkg-deb -x "$deb" "$HEADER_ROOT"
    done
    HEADER_BUILD="$HEADER_ROOT/usr/src/linux-headers-$KERNEL"
    [ -d "$HEADER_BUILD" ] || fail "downloaded headers do not contain $HEADER_BUILD"

    for path in "$HEADER_ROOT"/usr/src/linux-headers-*; do
        [ -d "$path" ] || continue
        name="$(basename "$path")"
        if [ -e "/usr/src/$name" ] || [ -L "/usr/src/$name" ]; then
            fail "/usr/src/$name already exists; refusing to replace it"
        fi
        ln -s "$path" "/usr/src/$name"
        CREATED_LINKS+=("/usr/src/$name")
    done

    MODULE_DIR="/usr/lib/modules/$KERNEL"
    mkdir -p "$MODULE_DIR"
    for name in build source; do
        path="$MODULE_DIR/$name"
        if [ -e "$path" ] || [ -L "$path" ]; then
            fail "$path already exists; refusing to replace it"
        fi
        ln -s "/usr/src/linux-headers-$KERNEL" "$path"
        CREATED_LINKS+=("$path")
    done

    for path in "$HEADER_ROOT"/usr/lib/linux-kbuild-*; do
        [ -d "$path" ] || continue
        name="$(basename "$path")"
        if [ ! -e "/usr/lib/$name" ] && [ ! -L "/usr/lib/$name" ]; then
            ln -s "$path" "/usr/lib/$name"
            CREATED_LINKS+=("/usr/lib/$name")
        fi
    done
}

[ "$EUID" -eq 0 ] || fail 'must run as root'
for command in apt-get apt-cache dpkg-query dpkg-deb python3 gpg getent modinfo; do
    command -v "$command" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "missing command: $command"
done

ARCH="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"
[ "$ARCH" = amd64 ] || fail "Oracle VirtualBox host packages require amd64 (detected: $ARCH)"
# shellcheck source=/etc/os-release
. /etc/os-release
CODENAME="${VERSION_CODENAME:-}"
[ -n "$CODENAME" ] || fail 'VERSION_CODENAME is missing from /etc/os-release'
VBOX_SUITE="$(map_virtualbox_suite "${ID:-}" "$CODENAME")" || fail "unsupported distribution: ${ID:-unknown} $CODENAME"
KERNEL="$(uname -r)"
HEADER_PACKAGE="linux-headers-$KERNEL"
mkdir -p "$WORK" "$GPG_HOME" "$SHIM_DIR"
chmod 0700 "$GPG_HOME"
installed_packages >"$BEFORE_PKGS"

printf 'Preparing VirtualBox for kernel %s (Oracle suite %s)\n' "$KERNEL" "$VBOX_SUITE"

download_file "$VBOX_KEY_URL" "$KEY_ASC"
KEY_FINGERPRINT="$(GNUPGHOME="$GPG_HOME" gpg --show-keys --with-colons "$KEY_ASC" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '$1 == "fpr" {print $10; exit}')"
[ "$KEY_FINGERPRINT" = "$VBOX_KEY_FINGERPRINT" ] || fail "unexpected Oracle signing-key fingerprint: ${KEY_FINGERPRINT:-none}"
GNUPGHOME="$GPG_HOME" gpg --batch --yes --dearmor --output "$KEYRING" "$KEY_ASC"
chmod 0644 "$KEYRING"

cat >"$VBOX_SOURCE" <<EOF
deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=$KEYRING] $VBOX_REPO $VBOX_SUITE contrib
EOF

apt-get update
HEADER_CANDIDATE="$(candidate_version "$HEADER_PACKAGE")"
if [ -z "$HEADER_CANDIDATE" ] || [ "$HEADER_CANDIDATE" = '(none)' ]; then
    add_kernel_repositories_from_manifest || fail "no usable kernel repository manifest for $KERNEL"
    apt-get update
    HEADER_CANDIDATE="$(candidate_version "$HEADER_PACKAGE")"
fi
if [ -z "$HEADER_CANDIDATE" ] || [ "$HEADER_CANDIDATE" = '(none)' ]; then
    fail "matching headers are unavailable: $HEADER_PACKAGE"
fi

download_header_tree

GCC_PACKAGE="$(grep -oE 'gcc-[0-9]+' /proc/version | head -n1 || true)"
[ -n "$GCC_PACKAGE" ] || fail 'cannot determine the compiler used to build the running kernel'
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "$GCC_PACKAGE" pahole
installed_packages >"$AFTER_BUILD_PKGS"
GCC_BIN="$(command -v "$GCC_PACKAGE")"
[ -x "$GCC_BIN" ] || fail "compiler executable is unavailable: $GCC_PACKAGE"
ln -s "$GCC_BIN" "$SHIM_DIR/gcc"
ln -s "$GCC_BIN" "$SHIM_DIR/cc"

VBOX_PACKAGE=''
for package in virtualbox-7.2 virtualbox-7.1 virtualbox-7.0 virtualbox-6.1; do
    candidate="$(candidate_version "$package")"
    if [ -n "$candidate" ] && [ "$candidate" != '(none)' ]; then
        VBOX_PACKAGE="$package"
        break
    fi
done
[ -n "$VBOX_PACKAGE" ] || fail "no supported Oracle VirtualBox package is available for $VBOX_SUITE"

printf 'Installing %s with %s\n' "$VBOX_PACKAGE" "$GCC_PACKAGE"
env PATH="$SHIM_DIR:$PATH" CC="$GCC_BIN" KBUILD_CC="$GCC_BIN" \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "$VBOX_PACKAGE"

if [ -x /sbin/rcvboxdrv ]; then
    if ! env PATH="$SHIM_DIR:$PATH" CC="$GCC_BIN" KBUILD_CC="$GCC_BIN" /sbin/rcvboxdrv setup; then
        cat /var/log/vbox-setup.log >&2 2>/dev/null || true
        fail 'VirtualBox kernel-module setup failed'
    fi
elif [ -x /usr/lib/virtualbox/vboxdrv.sh ]; then
    if ! env PATH="$SHIM_DIR:$PATH" CC="$GCC_BIN" KBUILD_CC="$GCC_BIN" /usr/lib/virtualbox/vboxdrv.sh setup; then
        cat /var/log/vbox-setup.log >&2 2>/dev/null || true
        fail 'VirtualBox kernel-module setup failed'
    fi
elif [ -x /sbin/vboxconfig ]; then
    if ! env PATH="$SHIM_DIR:$PATH" CC="$GCC_BIN" KBUILD_CC="$GCC_BIN" /sbin/vboxconfig; then
        cat /var/log/vbox-setup.log >&2 2>/dev/null || true
        fail 'VirtualBox kernel-module setup failed'
    fi
fi

depmod -a "$KERNEL"
for module in vboxdrv vboxnetflt vboxnetadp; do
    modinfo -k "$KERNEL" "$module" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "kernel module was not built: $module ($KERNEL)"
done

getent group vboxusers >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'VirtualBox did not create the vboxusers group'
install -d -m 0755 /usr/share/live/config/user-default-groups.d
printf '%s\n' vboxusers > /usr/share/live/config/user-default-groups.d/virtualbox.groups
chmod 0644 /usr/share/live/config/user-default-groups.d/virtualbox.groups

cleanup_build_dependencies

depmod -a "$KERNEL"
for module in vboxdrv vboxnetflt vboxnetadp; do
    modinfo -k "$KERNEL" "$module" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "kernel module disappeared after build cleanup: $module ($KERNEL)"
done

rm -f -- "$VBOX_SOURCE" "$KERNEL_SOURCE"
rm -f /var/lib/apt/lists/download.virtualbox.org_virtualbox_debian_* 2>/dev/null || true
apt-get clean
